served_model_selection: Highest macro-F1 on DS1 validation (grouped CV / held-out DS1 records). DS2 not used for selection.

class_descriptions.N: Normal / bundle-branch-block / escape beat (AAMI class N)
class_descriptions.F: Fusion of ventricular and normal beat (AAMI class F)

unsupported_classes.Q: Unclassifiable/paced beats: only ~15 examples after excluding paced records; not trained.

preprocessing.filters: 0.5 Hz high-pass, mains notch, 40 Hz low-pass (zero-phase Butterworth)
preprocessing.r_peaks_for_training: Reference annotations (.atr). At inference R-peaks come from the built-in detector.

dataset.name: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database v1.0.0 (PhysioNet)
dataset.relation_to_kaggle: Kaggle shayanfazeli/heartbeat is derived from this database; the raw records are used so record IDs are available for an inter-patient split.
dataset.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
dataset.split: de Chazal 2004 inter-patient: DS1 (22 records) train, DS2 (22 records) test; paced records 102,104,107,217 excluded

best_params.architecture: 3x(conv-bn-relu x2, maxpool) + GAP, RR branch, 2 dense

limitations: Classifies individual beats into 4 AAMI classes from a single lead. It is NOT a full ECG interpretation and does not detect ischaemia, conduction intervals, AF episodes, etc.
Trained on 2-lead ambulatory Holter recordings from 1975-1979 (47 subjects); performance on other devices, 12-lead resting ECGs or digitised paper ECGs is unknown and likely lower.
Inter-patient performance for S and F classes is known to be poor in the literature and is poor here as well; see per-class metrics.
Not clinically validated. Research/educational use only.
